adjudications.evidence: «Đối số lệnh» → «Tham số lệnh» (aria-label) and «Đối số» → «Tham số» (visible phase label). The popup now agrees with its own rows «Nhận tham số» / «Cần tham số» and with the count sentence «lệnh cần tham số». The surviving «Đối số» lives only in the settings integration form (arguments + one_per_line) on the /settings route (src/renderer/src/app.tsx:949), which cannot be co-visible with the chat composer's slash popup, so no user sees the two words side by side; both are correct vi for their objects. No glossary row covers «argument» yet — recording one is a core-repo style-guide task, not a defect in these bytes.

observations.text: The locale now names slash-command arguments «tham số» (this popup and the pre-existing «Nhận tham số» / «Cần tham số» rows) and CLI arguments in the settings integration form «đối số» (ui.settings.integrations.add_integration_form.arguments + its «(mỗi dòng một đối số)» hint). The two surfaces are different routes (/settings vs the chat composer) and cannot be co-visible, so there is no conflicting rendering; the vi style guide has no rule for either term. Proposed record for the guide: «tham số» for slash-command parameters, «đối số» for command-line arguments of an integration command.
